prompts:
Use case: game-environment panorama. Create the FINAL replacement prep-yard background for Human Last Rampart. Output an ultra-wide 3840x1080 panorama (32:9); entire image is art, no borders/UI/text. Reference image 1 is the EDIT TARGET for its exact wide framing, camera, pixel-art density, ground perspective and northern crenellated wall; replace architecture/layout as below. Image 2 is the actual current battle courtyard / K118 mockup: use layout, square stone lighthouse, road, very LOW perimeter buildings and material colors, NOT its diagonal aerial camera. Image 3 is K115 lighthouse design/material reference: tall straight SQUARE stone shaft (never cylindrical), iron-glazed lantern with bronze brazier and small fire, slate pyramidal cap, arched door and small warm lantern. Image 4 is actual courtyard facing the central tower: use road/lamp/plaza vocabulary only; no HUD or night sky. Image 5 is the K118 repair sign/front reference: chunky dark outlines, stone-and-hammer icon, matte materials.
Composition MUST retain the old frontal mildly elevated panorama viewpoint, broad ground plane and horizontal wall, not isometric, not aerial. Ground expands toward bottom; vanishing direction x=1920 toward top. Northern wall stretches horizontally behind low architecture. Keep the old image's foreground clear, floor extends bottom edge; no large foreground pillars. The 12m lighthouse is the focal point at x=1920 with ground foot approximately y=870, cap top y=36; narrow square shaft about 190px wide, lamp room 220px wide, round pale-stone plaza ellipse about 560px wide. 10 low buildings maximum height about 1/4 tower, distributed along perimeter, never crowd tower. Exactly TEN buildings: west (left) stone/slate repair hall and smithy with chimney; east (right) long terracotta/timber barracks and fenced stable; north (rear) small chapel with bell, timber granary and small shed; south (front outer sides) flat/slate trap workshop LEFT, terracotta/olive-awning shop RIGHT, and a small house to far right. Arrange WEST repair at x=650 y=470, smithy x=260 y=420; EAST barracks x=3120 y=470, stable x=3580 y=420. NORTH chapel x=1250 y=320, granary x=2520 y=320, shed x=2800 y=330. SOUTH trap workshop x=400 y=760, shop x=3260 y=760, house x=3720 y=710. All four functional fronts must face viewer enough to read silhouettes. Repair sign hammer+stone, barracks crossed spears, trap workshop spike-jaw trap, shop coin pouch. NO LETTERING. Make signs large enough to distinguish. Keep each function separate, no overlapping hotspots. Add only grounded well at south-left edge, modest hay near stable/granary, woodpile by smithy. Road of pale rectangular slabs leads from NORTH stair in the BACK CENTER toward round plaza, remaining visible to left of tower; 4 pairs of low black iron lamp posts border road, unlit in daylight. Road ends at plaza; do not turn into massive staircase or foreground avenue.
Art: intentional crisp chunky pixel art matching reference 1 and the approved HD-2D feel, solid pixel clusters, dark crisp outlines, roughly three shade groups per material. Worn grey/buff stone, warm desaturated brown cobbles, restrained terracotta, slate, olive awning. Clean morning directional sunlight from upper-left, distinct shadows down-right, neutral daylight (not golden sunset), no haze, no depth blur in play area, no bloom, glossy plastic, neon purple/teal or airbrushed gradients. Tower fire localized behind iron glazing. No people. No sea or ships. No generic ornate fantasy clutter. Keep entire tower visible. No labels, arrows, map symbols, UI, watermark. SAME 32:9 crop as edit target.

Edit the supplied approved first draft into the FINAL delivery layout, preserving all ten buildings, their locations and appearances, distinctive K118 signs, central square K115 tower, road, shadows, and crisp pixel-art style. Required delivery is 3840x1080 32:9, but the tool uses a 3:1 image. Therefore make a 3:1 outer canvas with a PERFECT 32:9 artwork strip centered vertically and completely solid magenta (#ff00ff) padding above and below: artwork height = 84.375% of total canvas height, top padding=7.8125%, bottom padding=7.8125%. For a 2160x720 canvas this means artwork y=56 to 664. ALL scene content (including tower finial and entire ground foreground) must lie inside the central artwork strip; padding contains no artwork. Recompose the scene within that strip, do not simply paint over/crop existing top and bottom. Widen the side field of view gently to retain old low frontal mildly elevated 32:9 preparation-yard camera. Inside artwork, tower base at 73% of art height, tower cap at 3%; rear functional buildings base at 57%, front shop and trap workshop base at 86%, broad walkable floor to bottom. The tower remains much taller than low perimeter buildings (12m tower vs <3m buildings). Keep 10 buildings exactly as supplied, no extras. Hammer+stone sign on west repair, crossed spears on east barracks, spike trap on southwest workshop, coin pouch on southeast olive-awning shop. Keep pale road from north center wall stair to round tower plaza, 4 pairs of low lamp posts. No lettering, UI, blur, bloom, haze, neon (except flat magenta padding outside artwork), glossy surfaces, or extra clutter. Strong neutral directional daylight, muted natural stone/wood/terracotta/olive. This padded image will be cropped only along the magenta bands to get the exact 32:9 final PNG; magenta must NOT appear inside the artwork.
processing: Crop padding, nearest-neighbor resample to native, exact nearest-neighbor 3x delivery and 4x preview. No Game assets edited.
